title: Solution Strategy Catalogue
description: Catalogue of strategic statements for the Solution architecture domain — the what and why at the highest level (outcomes, drivers, target states). Aligned to TOGAF Architecture Vision concepts with OKR-style target outcomes.

meta.description: A catalogue of strategic goals and direction for the Solution domain.
purpose: Establishes the organisation's intent for how cross-domain solutions are designed
Provides the strategic context for solution architecture investment and prioritisation
Aligns solution design with business outcomes spanning multiple architecture domains
Anchors solution principles and guardrails to a traceable set of intentions
Enables assessment of whether proposed solutions serve a coherent strategic purpose

statement.description: Strategic statement — outcome-oriented, time-bound where appropriate

driver.description: Business driver or external force motivating this strategy

target-outcome.description: Measurable success criterion (what does success look like?)
